---
title: "A Typst theme with a code fill and a top rule"
filters:
  - code-window
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
---

```{=typst}
#state("code-window-theme").update((
  border: rgb("#ff0000"),
  fill: rgb("#00ff00"),
  stroke: (top: 3pt + rgb("#0000ff"), rest: none),
))
```

The window below draws a blue top rule and no other side, and its code takes
the green fill. The line below the title bar keeps the red border colour.

```{.python filename="a.py"}
x = 1
```

The block below has no window, and also takes the green fill.

```{.python code-window-enabled="false"}
y = 2
```
